svg.title: Conditional estimates need qualified end-to-end evidence
svg.desc: Independent context-pair and held-out error references • no measured cost model
svg.text: Conditional estimates need qualified end-to-end evidence
Independent context-pair and held-out error references • no measured cost model
Six queries do not define context cost
Fresh prompt four + two decode inputs
Decode context8: W28; context1024: W2060
Difference2032 logical causal pairs
Synthetic predictor is not a fitted result
Predicted4.056 versus8.120 ms
Real shape, graph, traffic and overlap differ
A point estimate can miss the allowance
Forecast4 ms; remaining allowance5 ms
Stipulated validation4.1 / 4.3 / 6.0 ms
Last residual2 ms; allowance breach1 ms
Tune first; confirm on fresh workloads
Freeze online features, objectives and caps
Preserve failed, blocked and unknown clients
Inspect class service, memory and recovery
Device timing forecasts do not automatically cover client-visible selection, delivery or parsing.
Use independent residuals and declared fallback; finite errors cannot prove an arbitrary future bound.
